claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (APV-CMV, PEEP 5, FiO2 40%) and monitor airway pressures and minute volume.
Monitor serum troponin trend given elevated troponin T (0.11 to 0.14 to 0.07 ng/mL) and obtain serial ECGs.
Monitor coagulation panel (PTT elevated at 65.3-67.6 sec) and assess for bleeding risk.
Obtain sputum culture and sensitivity to guide antibiotic therapy for suspected infection (WBC 13.2 K/uL).
Monitor blood glucose closely (finger sticks 138-168 mg/dL) and adjust insulin therapy as needed.
Continue enteral nutrition with Glucerna 1.2 at 15 mL/hour.
Monitor vancomycin trough level (7.5 ug/mL) and adjust dosing to maintain therapeutic range.
Perform daily sedation interruption and assess readiness for extubation given Richmond-RAS -1 to 0 and spontaneous breathing trials.
Monitor arterial blood gas or venous blood gas to assess acid-base status and oxygenation (pH 7.47, pCO2 47, pO2 51 on venous).
Maintain head-of-bed elevation and pressure ulcer prevention measures (Braden score indicates risk).
